title: acer ginnala subsp. semenovii
intro: Acer ginnala subsp. semenovii, commonly known as Amur maple or Korean maple, is a subspecies of deciduous shrub or small tree in the family Sapindaceae. The health benefits of Acer ginnala subsp. semenovii include its use in traditional medicine to treat various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin problems due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity, which is a result of its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids.
